primary_metric.name: same-12-source-clip dominant native-ID recurrence
primary_metric.unresolved_rule: Any pair with an unresolved clip is unresolved, never correct.
primary_metric.duration_rule: Only source-mapped positive-duration spans contribute; same-ID overlap is deduplicated; no temporal gap is bridged.

anchor_reference.selection: Midpoints of lexical final tokens from Soniox continuous.json, using the eligibility checks in soniox_diarization/probe.py metrics().
anchor_reference.reference_use: Locations and original fixture speaker labels only; no reference labels or anchor list were sent to any inference run.
anchor_reference.eligibility: Alphanumeric token text; numeric start_ms/end_ms; midpoint maps through exactly one timeline part to source audio; exactly one fixture truth interval contains it; native speaker ID is present and non-boolean, as in the old metrics().
